title: Layer 3 round 3 minor collector SE: the cleaning trust model is inconsistent — free-form registry strings (next_step_text, human_recovery) render raw while the enum kind is cleaned; #786's registered-absence source is dead behind acquire.rs's upstream hardcode; the empty-fallback empty-slot with renderer disagreement

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 94d3c2cf: the free-form registry strings now cross the cleaner uniformly — human.rs's next_step and broken.rs's human_recovery join diagnostic.message and kind, so the trust model is consistent (every terminal-destined string cleaned regardless of source); the misleading broken.rs comment is corrected. registered_absence takes fit()'s loud posture (expect on a drifted registry, never a silent empty slot), so the two renderers fail the same way. And #786's anti-drift purpose is now met at the operative layer: acquire.rs's absence wordings are named constants (ABSENT_SESSION/WORK_ITEM/MILESTONE) with a fidelity test pinning the two that have registered counterparts to the data set's absence_text — an edit to either side turns the pin red. Session has no registered display field (the demotion), so it carries no mirror, stated.
